results_due: late January to mid-February 2027, going by when Q2 was reported (28 Oct to 6 Nov)
reasoning: The August call guided about 20% FY27 revenue growth on FY26's ₹947 Cr, about ₹1,140 Cr. H1 was ₹506 Cr, so H2 needs about ₹634 Cr, about ₹317 Cr a quarter. Order book is about ₹2,010 Cr. We assume ₹320 Cr in Q3 (+13% on Q3 FY26's ₹284 Cr, +17% on Q2).

The Global Coil Factory in Sangli and the Turkish PCS plant started in October, but both are still ramping (management's own priority is stabilising throughput), so Q3 gets only part of their output. WS Insulators is expected to be consolidated from Q4, not Q3.
Margin: guidance is about 20% (16-20% in the August call); Q2 was 23% and Q3 FY26 28%. We use 21%. PAT is helped by other income, so it is close to operating profit.

2 Nov call (transcript): the Joint MD said Q3 'would be a kind of a tough time at Quality Power' (standalone coil business, about ₹220 Cr of revenue last year) while production moves to the new Sangli factory, 'but I still wouldn't see numbers going down much'; Mehru can improve, and Turkey PCS billing 'may commence' in Q3. FY27 guidance was left unchanged until the end of Q3. We therefore cut the base from ₹320 Cr to ₹305 Cr and the range accordingly; margin stays about 21% (stable group guidance about 20%).
risks: New plants ramp slower than planned
Lumpy export deliveries shift revenue between quarters
WS Insulators closing timing and costs
Q3 standalone weakness during the factory move is worse than 'not down much'
caveat: The 2 Nov 2026 call transcript was not yet on Screener when this estimate was made; the guidance used is from the August call and the Nov presentation.
